key_insight: A spray distance of 190 mm produced the densest Cr3C2–NiCr coating and the best acid-corrosion resistance on DSS 2205.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing D-gun spray distance is a practical process lever for improving coating integrity and extending service life in acidic industrial environments.
method: D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm.
Tested coated samples in 1 M H2SO4 at room temperature using OCP, EIS, and potentiodynamic polarization.
Examined surface morphology and porosity by SEM.
Compared corrosion behavior against the uncoated substrate.
evidence_signal: Porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, and the 190 mm coating showed the lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy) versus 2.60 mmpy for uncoated DSS 2205.
watch_item: Results are based on a single acidic electrolyte and room-temperature lab testing, so performance may differ under other temperatures, acids, or long-term service conditions.
paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
